npcs.name: Brynjolf
npcs.greet: Never done an honest day's work in your life for all that coin you're carrying, eh lass? Or lad. The light's poor.

npcs.name: Mercer Frey
npcs.greet: Brynjolf vouches for you. That buys you a seat at the table. Keeping it is up to you.

npcs.name: Delvin Mallory
npcs.greet: Business has been terrible since the curse. Not that I believe in curses. Mostly.

npcs.name: Vex
npcs.greet: Don't touch anything. And don't talk to me unless it's about money.

npcs.name: Karliah
npcs.greet: Twenty-five years I've waited for someone to hear the truth. Sit, and listen.

npcs.name: Maven Black-Briar
npcs.greet: If you're here to beg, the Temple of Mara is down the street. If you're here to work, sit down and close your mouth.

npcs.name: Keerava
npcs.greet: The Bee and Barb serves drink and food. Trouble, it does not serve.

npcs.name: Bersi Honey-Hand
npcs.greet: Pottery, fine pottery. And if you break it, you've bought it.

npcs.name: Haelga
npcs.greet: Dibella blesses all who come to her with an open heart. Or an open purse.

npcs.name: Sabjorn
npcs.greet: Honningbrew mead, best in the hold. Or it will be, once I get rid of these skeevers.

relics.name: Goldenglow Bill of Sale
relics.desc: Proof that someone has quietly bought Goldenglow Estate out from under its owner.

relics.name: Vial of Skeever Bane
relics.desc: Labeled pest poison. It is not pest poison.

relics.name: Gallus's Encoded Journal
relics.desc: Written in old Falmer script. Someone in Winterhold might read it.

relics.name: The Eyes of the Falmer
relics.desc: Two great gems pried from a Dwemer statue. Worth more than most towns.

relics.name: The Skeleton Key
relics.desc: Nocturnal's own key. It opens anything: locks, doors, minds.

karliah_truth: I didn't murder Gallus. Mercer Frey did, and he stole the Skeleton Key from the Twilight Sepulcher. The Guild's bad luck is Nocturnal's displeasure.
Gallus kept a journal. It's in an old script I can't read. If we can read it, the Guild will believe us.
nightingale_oath: In the hall of the Nightingales, Karliah leads you before a great stone circle. The shadows deepen until they feel like a held breath.
So. Another stands before me. Serve me as Nightingale, in life and after, and I will grant you my shadow. Return what was stolen.
That was Nocturnal. Now we hunt Mercer.
nocturnal_return: The Skeleton Key slides into the Ebonmere. The pool of darkness ripples, and a figure of shadow and feathers rises from it.
The Key is home. You have done what you swore. The Guild's luck is restored, and you are mine, Nightingale. Walk in shadow.
Karliah. I'm free. Thank you, friend.

quests.title: A Chance Arrangement
quests.offer: What kind of work are you offering?
quests.pitch: Something a bit shady. Lift a ring from a market stall and plant it on a merchant. Do it clean, and there's more where that came from. Meet me in the Ragged Flagon after.
quests.desc: Brynjolf, a fast talker in Riften's market, offered me work for coin: steal something unnoticed, then meet him in the Ragged Flagon under the city.

objectives.text: Steal something in Riften without being caught
Find the Ragged Flagon in the Ratway

objectives.reply: Clean work. Welcome to the Thieves Guild, then. Mercer Frey runs things here, but you'll deal with me. First, we have a few debts to collect.

quests.title: Taking Care of Business
quests.desc: Brynjolf wants three of Riften's merchants reminded that they owe the Guild: Keerava, Bersi Honey-Hand and Haelga.

objectives.reply: Tell Brynjolf he will have it. And tell him to stop sending strangers to my bar.

objectives.topic: You owe the Guild. Pay up, or the pottery pays.
objectives.reply: Not the urn! Fine, fine. Here. Take it and get out.

objectives.topic: Brynjolf sent me about your debt.
objectives.reply: Dibella forgive me, I meant to pay. Here. And not a word about the... visitors to my bunkhouse.
That's the way. Next job is bigger: Maven Black-Briar wants the Goldenglow Estate taught a lesson.

quests.title: Loud and Clear
quests.desc: The owner of Goldenglow Estate, the honey farm on the lake, has stopped paying the Guild. Maven Black-Briar, our best client, wants the estate hurt badly, and wants to know who's backing its owner.

objectives.journal: Inside the safe was a bill of sale. Someone else bought Goldenglow, and signed it with a mark: a stylized sun.

objectives.text: Bring the bill of sale to Brynjolf
objectives.reply: A buyer with a sun for a signature... Honningbrew Meadery has the same mark on its barrels. That's next. Maven will be pleased.

quests.title: Dampened Spirits
quests.desc: Honningbrew Meadery is cutting into the Black-Briar mead trade, and whoever bought Goldenglow is behind it. Maven wants Honningbrew ruined at its own tasting.

objectives.text: Talk to Sabjorn at Honningbrew Meadery
objectives.topic: I hear you have a skeever problem.
objectives.reply: Problem? An infestation! Clear out the basement and I'll pay you. Here, put this bane on the nests. Careful, it's strong.

objectives.text: Clear the skeevers from the meadery cellar

objectives.topic: Sabjorn's 'pest poison' is something else entirely.
objectives.reply: Captain of the guard tastes it at the opening, Sabjorn hangs, Honningbrew is mine. You have a future, thief.

quests.title: Scoundrel's Folly
quests.desc: The sun mark belongs to a rival, and the trail leads to Snow Veil Sanctum, where a Guild traitor named Karliah may be hiding. Mercer Frey wants her dead.

objectives.topic: Brynjolf says you have a job for me.
objectives.reply: Karliah. She murdered our last Guild Master, Gallus, twenty-five years ago. Now she's back. She's hiding in Snow Veil Sanctum. You're coming with me.

objectives.text: Meet Mercer at Snow Veil Sanctum

objectives.reply: Mercer said that? Mercer shot you in the back a moment ago. Look at the wound. Then listen to me.

objectives.topic: Mercer's been robbing the Guild blind. Gallus wrote it down.
objectives.reply: Mercer... the vault! He's emptied the vault! Go with Karliah. I'll hold the Guild together. Find him.

quests.title: Trinity Restored
quests.desc: Karliah was a Nightingale, one of three agents sworn to the Daedric Prince Nocturnal. To catch Mercer we need Nocturnal's favor, and the Nightingale armor waiting in Nightingale Hall.

objectives.text: Take the Nightingale oath with Karliah
objectives.reply: Then stand on the circle. Don't speak until she does.

quests.title: Blindsighted
quests.desc: Mercer Frey is after the Eyes of the Falmer, the great gems of the Dwemer ruin Irkngthand. That's where we'll catch him.

objectives.text: Fight through the Falmer of Irkngthand

objectives.topic: Mercer is dead. I have the Key.
objectives.reply: Then there's one thing left. The Key goes home to the Twilight Sepulcher. Keep the gems; the Guild needs them more than Nocturnal does.

quests.title: Darkness Returns
quests.desc: The Skeleton Key must be returned to the Ebonmere in the Twilight Sepulcher, Nocturnal's temple. Only then will the Guild's luck return.

objectives.text: Return the Skeleton Key to the Ebonmere
Return to Brynjolf in the Ragged Flagon
objectives.topic: It's done. The Key is home.
objectives.reply: I can feel it already: the coin's flowing again. The Guild needs a Guild Master, and nobody's earned it like you.
